about: Statistics Finland's PxWeb statistical databases (StatFin, Paavo postal-code data, etc.). The CLI uses the public PxWeb API v1 to browse databases, subject areas and tables, search tables, read table metadata and query table data.

commands.summary: List all databases on the server (StatFin, Postinumeroalueittainen_avoin_tieto, Hyvinvointialueet, ...)
List the top-level subject areas (folders) of a database, e.g. StatFin subject areas like vaerak (population structure)
List the tables (type 't') or sub-levels (type 'l') inside a subject area of a database

params.name: area
params.description: Subject area id from list-subject-areas, e.g. vaerak, kuol, matk (for Paavo: uusin or arkisto)

commands.summary: Search a database's tables by free text, title words or variable value codes; query=* with filter=* lists every table with publish dates

params.name: lang
params.description: Language of texts and of the search index

params.name: query
params.description: Search text, a value code (e.g. KU091 municipality code), or * for all tables

params.name: filter
params.description: Restrict where to match: title = table titles only, codes = variable value codes, * = everything (use with query=* to list all tables). Omit for default full-text search.

commands.summary: Get a table's title and variables, with each variable's code, value codes and value texts (needed before querying data)

params.name: area
params.description: Subject area id. This is the search result 'path' without the leading slash, e.g. vaerak

params.name: table
params.description: Table id including the .px suffix, e.g. 11rc.px

commands.summary: Query a table's data values, selecting on one variable (e.g. latest N years with filter=top on timeperiod_y); all other variables return all values

params.name: code
params.description: Variable code to select on (from get-table-metadata variables[].code). StatFin tables use timeperiod_y for years.

params.name: filter
params.description: Selection type: item = a specific value code, top = latest N values (value is N), all = every value (value *)

params.name: value
params.description: Value code for filter=item (e.g. 2024, SSS), a count for filter=top (e.g. 5), or * for filter=all

params.name: format
params.description: Response format. json gives columns plus data[{key:[codes], values:[...]}]; json-stat2 is the compact JSON-stat format

commands.summary: Get the API's usage limits: max cells/values per query, max calls per time window, CORS
